modsH: Six ways we turn sign-ups into funded accounts
name: Fintech

hero.s: Fintech behavioural insights. We study how people decide with money, then make safety clear.

insights.title: Trust comes before features
insights.text: People hand over money only when they feel safe. Show safety before speed.

insights.title: Too many products, no pick
insights.text: Crowded menus freeze decisions. A clear starter option gets people moving.

insights.title: Losses loom larger
insights.text: Fear of losing money outweighs the promise of earning it. Frame protection first.

insights.title: Old banks win on habit
insights.text: People keep the account they know. Make switching feel small and reversible.

mapH: Where users stall, and what we change

mods.title: Customer insight sprint
mods.text: Interviews and money diaries find the real fear.

mods.title: Behavioural audit
mods.text: We score each step for trust, effort and risk.

mods.title: Onboarding redesign
mods.text: Flows rebuilt to lower fear and effort.

mods.title: Trust-led acquisition
mods.text: Media that shows safety before speed.

mods.title: Retention and habit
mods.text: Nudges that make saving and repaying automatic.

mods.title: Product storytelling
mods.text: Films that explain money in plain words.

faq.question: How long does a behavioural insight engagement take in fintech?
faq.answer: An insight sprint runs 4 to 6 weeks. Redesign and media work follow in phases, each focused on one step from sign-up to first use.

faq.question: Do you work with regulated financial products?
faq.answer: Yes. Creative and claims follow financial promotion rules, and we design for clarity so people can see the risks as well as the benefits.

faq.question: How do you measure impact on user behaviour?
faq.answer: Against one agreed behaviour per phase, such as an account opened or a first deposit made. The baseline is agreed before work starts.

faq.question: Is customer data kept safe?
faq.answer: We sign an NDA before any data is shared and work within your security and privacy policies.

cta.p: A 15-minute fit call. We bring a first read of where your users hesitate.
